about: Tedra L. Cannella, an attorney with Cannella Snyder LLC in Decatur, Georgia, helps clients address Personal Injury - Products: Plaintiff situations. She also helps clients with Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff, Business Litigation and Class Action / Mass Torts: Plaintiff concerns.
She received legal training from University of Georgia School of Law. She graduated from law school in 2007. Tedra Cannella became licensed to practice law in 2007.
Tedra Cannella was selected to Super Lawyers. The designation means that she is a top-rated attorney as recognized by peers. She was selected to Super Lawyers for 2019 - 2027.
